records.title: ci: keep Arvin production moving with guarded GitHub orchestrator
records.body:
Maximum Parallel automation lane. Adds an opt-in GitHub-native production orchestrator so validated lanes can progress without waiting for a chat turn.

Behavior:
- runs after Arvin Fast/Build/Device completions, every 8 minutes, and manually
- touches only PRs explicitly labeled `arvin-auto`
- Draft PR: marks Ready only after exact-head Parallel Wave success whose recorded PR base SHA equals current `main`
- Ready PR: squash-merges only after exact-head Arvin Build + Device Smoke both succeed and both recorded PR base SHAs equal current `main`
- rechecks main, PR head/state/draft and mergeability immediately before merge
- serializes production merges: at most one merge per invocation; every remaining lane must revalidate against new main
- no force push/rebase/history rewrite; no unlabeled PR automation

Contract test now locks the 8-minute fallback cadence plus the safety properties. Keep Draft for Fast CI, then promote only after current-main validation and heavy gates.
